title: Bind Research OS capability flags to execution kind

proposal_scope.title: Bind Research OS capability flags to execution kind
proposal_scope.hypothesis: Deriving Research OS execution capability flags from both lifecycle status and the approved execution_kind will prevent a synthetic RUNNING event from claiming real-data authority, while preserving the existing exact-scope synthetic and real-data transition contracts.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: Capability flags remain status-only, synthetic RUNNING can claim real-data permission, RUNNING can be entered with no execution kind, or the correction weakens GitHub approval verification, exact run-scope verification, production safety, or BUY safety.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The GPT-to-Codex research loop must distinguish harmless synthetic contract checks from authorized real-race evaluation. Incorrect capability labels can cause operators or future adapters to treat a synthetic approval as permission to read race, odds, result, or payout data, undermining leakage controls and the validity of ROI evidence.
proposal_scope.target_population: Synthetic Research OS lifecycle transitions only; no horse, race, odds, payout, result, historical OOS, or prospective rows.
in_scope: Bind real_data_execution_allowed to RUNNING plus execution_kind real-data
Bind synthetic_fixture_tests_allowed during RUNNING to execution_kind synthetic
Keep all post-run execution capability flags false
Reject RUNNING when execution_kind is none
Use injected GitHub approval fixtures with no external network
rejection_gate: Any GitHub approval, run-scope, commit, or dirty-worktree verification becomes weaker
Any external API, real data, production, notification, purchase, or order side effect
Any pre-registered synthetic contract case fails
Any real-data permission exists outside RUNNING with execution_kind=real-data
Any synthetic RUNNING event records real_data_execution_allowed=true
stop_conditions: A change reaches outside the two approved implementation paths
A change weakens approval revalidation or run-scope hash checks
A fixture attempts network, external API, real-data, production, notification, or purchase access
raw_data_sources: Git-tracked Research OS lifecycle implementation at base commit 385a418827fd6d1cbf9868507d53ad7a04fe172d
Observed EXP-20260808-030 synthetic RUNNING registry event
out_of_scope: Actual external API or GitHub network calls in tests
Actual real-data execution, backtests, OOS evaluation, or ROI calculation
Automatic merge, shadow approval, production deployment, or formal BUY
Changes to feature, model, calibrator, candidate, value, dashboard, or purchase logic
GPT provider or Codex dispatcher implementation

notes: Follow-up safety correction discovered during EXP-20260808-030 review; proposal only, no implementation or execution.
